title: Interactive Spectroscopy Peak Viewer
prompt:
Create a single HTML file using Three.js that implements an interactive spectroscopy peak viewer in 3D space. The scene visualizes a simulated IR absorption spectrum with interactive peak selection, annotation, and analysis tools.

## Scene Setup
- Use an OrthographicCamera looking down the Z-axis so the spectrum appears as a 2D chart rendered in 3D space.
- Camera frustum: left=-10, right=10, top=6, bottom=-6, near=0.1, far=100. Position camera at (0, 0, 20) looking at origin.
- Background color: #1a1a2e (dark navy).
- Add ambient light (intensity 0.8) and a directional light from (5, 5, 10) with intensity 0.6.

## Spectrum Data
- Generate a synthetic IR spectrum along the X-axis from x=-9 (wavenumber 4000 cm⁻¹) to x=9 (wavenumber 400 cm⁻¹). The X-axis maps linearly: wavenumber = 4000 - ((x + 9) / 18) * 3600.
- The baseline transmittance is 95% (y ≈ 4.75 in scene units, where y range 0-5 maps to 0-100% transmittance).
- Create exactly 6 absorption peaks as downward dips (Gaussian shape) at these wavenumbers with these depths (in transmittance %):
  1. Peak A: 3400 cm⁻¹, depth 60%, label "O-H stretch"
  2. Peak B: 2950 cm⁻¹, depth 45%, label "C-H stretch"
  3. Peak C: 1720 cm⁻¹, depth 70%, label "C=O stretch"
  4. Peak D: 1450 cm⁻¹, depth 35%, label "C-H bend"
  5. Peak E: 1050 cm⁻¹, depth 55%, label "C-O stretch"
  6. Peak F: 750 cm⁻¹, depth 40%, label "C-H oop bend"
- Each Gaussian has a width (sigma) of 0.3 in scene X-units.
- Render the spectrum as a smooth line using THREE.Line with LineBasicMaterial (color: #00ff88, linewidth: 2). Use at least 500 points.
- Draw X-axis and Y-axis lines in white. Add tick marks along X-axis at every 500 cm⁻¹ and Y-axis at every 20% transmittance using small line segments.

## Peak Markers
- At each peak minimum, place a small sphere (radius 0.12, color: #ff4444) as a clickable marker.
- When no peak is selected, all markers are red (#ff4444).
- The currently selected peak marker turns yellow (#ffff00) and scales to 1.5x size.

## Interactions

### Mouse Click (Raycasting)
- Clicking on a peak marker selects that peak. Only one peak can be selected at a time.
- Clicking empty space deselects the current peak.

### Keyboard Controls
- Left/Right Arrow: cycle through peaks in order (A→B→C→D→E→F→A). If no peak is selected, Right selects Peak A, Left selects Peak F.
- Up Arrow: increase the depth of the selected peak by 5% transmittance (peak gets shallower / less absorption). Clamp depth to minimum 5%.
- Down Arrow: increase absorption depth of selected peak by 5% (peak gets deeper). Clamp depth to maximum 90%.
- 'Z' key: Undo the last depth modification (maintain a history stack of up to 20 modifications).
- 'Y' key: Redo the last undone modification.
- 'R' key: Reset all peaks to their original depths.
- 'T' key: Toggle between transmittance mode (peaks go down) and absorbance mode (peaks go up, baseline at bottom). This flips the Y-axis interpretation.

### DOM Controls
- Add a panel (div) at top-right with id="info-panel" showing:
  - Currently selected peak label and wavenumber, or "No peak selected"
  - Current depth (transmittance %) of selected peak
  - Current mode: "Transmittance" or "Absorbance"
- Add a button with id="btn-reset" that resets all peaks (same as 'R' key).
- Add a button with id="btn-toggle-mode" that toggles transmittance/absorbance (same as 'T' key).
- Add a slider input with id="slider-width" (range 0.1 to 1.0, step 0.05, default 0.3) that adjusts the Gaussian width (sigma) of ALL peaks simultaneously. The spectrum must re-render when the slider changes.

## State Management
- Expose window.__3D_STATE__ with these fields:
  - peakCount: number (always 6)
  - selectedPeakIndex: number (-1 if none, 0-5 for peaks A-F)
  - selectedPeakLabel: string (e.g., "O-H stretch" or "")
  - selectedPeakWavenumber: number (e.g., 3400, or 0 if none)
  - peakDepths: array of 6 numbers (current depth percentages, e.g., [60, 45, 70, 35, 55, 40])
  - originalDepths: array of 6 numbers (always [60, 45, 70, 35, 55, 40])
  - gaussianSigma: number (current sigma value)
  - mode: string ("transmittance" or "absorbance")
  - undoStackSize: number (number of items in undo history)
  - redoStackSize: number (number of items in redo history)
  - totalAbsorptionArea: number (sum of all peak depths, used as a conservation-like metric)
  - spectrumPointCount: number (number of points in the rendered line)
  - markersVisible: boolean (true if peak markers are in the scene)
  - lastAction: string (last action performed, e.g., "select", "deselect", "depth_increase", "depth_decrease", "undo", "redo", "reset", "toggle_mode", "sigma_change", "init")

## Rendering
- Use requestAnimationFrame loop.
- Whenever peak depths or sigma change, regenerate the spectrum line geometry.
- Ensure the spectrum line, axes, markers, and labels all update correctly on every change.
physics_constraints: Peak depths must be clamped between 5% and 90%. Gaussian sigma must be clamped between 0.1 and 1.0. Undo/redo must perfectly restore previous states. totalAbsorptionArea must always equal the exact sum of all current peakDepths. Wavenumber mapping must be linear: wn = 4000 - ((x+9)/18)*3600. Mode toggle must invert the visual representation without changing stored depth values.
